# cb:b030 · source-type-taxonomy

> Attestation source identifiers follow a structured taxonomy split into authorship sources (record who/when formalized a claim; valid on any type) and artifact sources (cite a specific document; attestation-only)

**Type:** prescription (contract-grade) · **Kind:** domain-rule · **Domain:** system · **Status:** active
**Tags:** `dag-schema`, `provenance`
**Created:** 2026-04-12

## Invariants

- Every active attestation has a non-null source
- Source prefix determines the expected downstream resource shape
- Authorship sources (policy, legacy, user:, manual:, session:) are valid on any type
- Artifact sources (gmail:, source:, paper:, URLs, file paths) are attestation-only
- Non-attestations cite external documents through deps, never through source directly

## Rules

```json
{
  "given": "An attestation is being written",
  "scenario": "Valid source prefixes",
  "then": "The source must match one of: artifact prefixes (gmail:, source:, analysis:, transcript:, paper:, https://, a repository file path); authorship prefixes (user:, manual:, session:); or authorship sentinels (policy, legacy)",
  "when": "The source field is validated"
}
{
  "given": "A node records who/when a claim was formalized",
  "scenario": "Authorship sources apply to any type",
  "then": "Authorship sources (policy, legacy, user:<person>:<date>, manual:<person>:<date>, session:<date>) may appear on any structural type - a declared contract legitimately carries session:<date> to record when it was articulated",
  "when": "The source field is populated"
}
{
  "given": "A node has type aggregation or implication",
  "scenario": "Artifact sources are attestation-only",
  "then": "The source must not use artifact prefixes (gmail:, source:, analysis:, transcript:, paper:, URLs, file paths) - non-attestations reference specific documents via deps, not via source",
  "when": "The source field is checked"
}
```
